description: Limit-up summary for a trade date: limit_up_count / broken_count + ever_broken_count / limit_down_count / max_height / ladder[{height, count}]. Two seal-break measures: `broken_count` = INSTANTANEOUS boards open right now (day high touched the limit, currently unsealed; auction touches included); `ever_broken_count` = CUMULATIVE 当日曾炸板家数 (sealed ≥9:30 then broke for ≥30 consecutive seconds, re-sealed included). ⚠️ Different populations, NOT nested — ever_broken_count can be lower than broken_count; never subtract them. '现在多少没封住' → broken_count; '今天封过又开过' → ever_broken_count. ⚠️ Our own measure, not comparable with terminals, and not across 2026-08-25 (rule change). Pre-open fallback applies.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

include.description: active = all_a_ex_st 口径（默认）; all = all_a 口径

trade_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; omit for latest

name: limit_up_summary
